comment: Independent seeds 6630218/6630219 (debug mode). The Valkyrie writes ".,abc" in the dust and fights from that square, which wipes the leading '.' to a space that wipe_engr_at() skips. A level teleport away and back runs the checkpoint save_currentstate() on arrival, whose save_engravings() moves the text pointer back to the buffer start, so the live text regains the leading space. After #save and restore, restore.c getlev() -> engrave.c rest_engravings() skips leading spaces again, so reading the engraving on the restored level shows no leading space.
